criteria: Elements, elemental reactions, Visions, Delusions and other power systems, physics, and gameplay mechanics (labelled).
notes: Generated from the discovery research pass on 2026-10-11 and maintained by hand afterwards. Status is computed by tools/check_coverage.py --sync.

items.name: Physical laws and roleplay physics
items.notes: Project guidance (lore_status mixed/roleplay_adaptation): ordinary biology and survival, ageing and lifespans, food/sleep/exhaustion, travel and communication, medicine and healing, injury and recovery, death, weather hazards, elemental damage, water/drowning/pressure, explosions and structural damage, magic limits, teleportation, dimensional boundaries, resurrection - grounded in canon examples, clearly separating canon from recommended interpretation.

items.name: Anemo
items.notes: Element of wind; Archon Barbatos (Mondstadt).

items.name: Cryo
items.notes: Element of ice; the wiki currently names the associated Archon as Vassaga (Snezhnaya). Check this against the 7.x story.

items.name: Delusion
items.notes: Fatui-made Vision-like devices, thought to use divine remains, that harm the user. | merged term.delusion: Fatui artificial Vision analogues that drain life; glossary pointer to system.delusions.

items.name: Dendro
items.notes: Element of plants; Archon Buer (Sumeru). Playable from 3.0.

items.name: Electro
items.notes: Element of lightning; Archon Beelzebul (Inazuma).

items.name: Elemental Reaction
items.notes: Hub page: aura and trigger table; transformative vs amplifying reactions; Lunar and Stellar Glimmer subsets.

items.name: Element
items.notes: Overview of the seven Elements, their Archons and the elemental system. Hub entry.

items.name: Geo
items.notes: Element of earth; Archon Morax (Liyue).

items.name: Hydro
items.notes: Element of water; Archon was Focalors (Fontaine). Wiki now uses past tense for the Hydro Archon.

items.name: Nightsoul's Blessing
items.notes: Natlan power state, including Nightsoul Burst. Tied to the Night Kingdom and the Wayob, and to Ancient Name bearers.

items.name: Pyro
items.notes: Element of fire; wiki names the associated Archon as Haborym (Natlan).

items.name: Vision
items.notes: Gods' eyes granted to allogenes, people with strong desires who may ascend to Celestia. Also covers the term 'allogenes'. | merged term.vision: Glossary pointer; the system entry (system.visions) holds mechanics.

items.name: Alchemy
items.notes: Alchemy in lore: Mondstadt, Sumeru and Snezhnayan bio-alchemy (Koshchei, Hvergelmir, Aberrant Chimeric Monsters). The 'Alchemy' wiki page is the crafting mechanic.

items.name: Arkhe
items.notes: Opposing Pneuma and Ousia energies (Annihilation). Covers both Pneuma and Ousia, which redirect here.

items.name: Art of Khemia
items.notes: Khaenri'ahn life-creating alchemy (Rhinedottir, Albedo, Durin). | Khaenri'ahn alchemy focused on creating life (Rhinedottir, Albedo, Durin). | merged lore.art-of-khemia: Khaenri'ahn life-creating alchemy (Rhinedottir, Albedo); major factor in the Cataclysm.

items.name: Constellation
items.notes: Both a lore concept (each person's star fate) and a gameplay upgrade.

items.name: Eitr
items.notes: Embryonic-Ichoric-Telluric-Rudiment: a Hyperborean creation that holds Light Realm power and is used to alter organisms. | merged item.eitr: Embryonic-Ichoric-Telluric-Rudiment; Hyperborean Light-Realm life-altering creation; Ronova fused it with a Nail in 7.1. Introduced 7.x - exact version unverified.

items.name: Immortality and Resurrection
items.notes: Synthesis entry (no single wiki page): Khaenri'ahn curse of immortality, adeptal longevity, zombies (Qiqi), Natlan's Ode of Resurrection, Ronova and the cycle of life and death. Sources: Ode of Resurrection, Zombie, Erosion, Khaenri'ah/History.

items.name: Kresnik Kristall
items.notes: Snezhnaya's heat-energy source: Kresnik's Torch is an artificial heat source fueled by Kresnik Kristall ore. A separate 'Kresnik Kristall' page exists for the exploration ore. | merged item.kresnik-kristall: Snezhnaya energy ore (Kresnik Energy for the Eye of Graeae).

items.name: Lunar Reaction
items.notes: A subset of reactions that need a Moonsign Benediction character, can CRIT, and are powered by kuuvahki. The wiki lists Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom and Lunar-Crystallize.

items.name: Moon Wheel
items.notes: Nod-Krai Vision-like objects 'formed from the stuff of the soul' that channel kuuvahki. Version is inferred from the first Moon Wheel characters (Luna I).

items.name: Moonsign
items.notes: Party bonus with Nascent Gleam and Ascendant Gleam tiers, raised by Moonsign Benediction Passives. Wiki section: Team Bonus#Moonsign.

items.name: Mystic Arts in Teyvat
items.notes: Overview of magic and ritual traditions by nation (alchemy, adeptal arts, exorcism, onmyoudou, witchcraft...). | merged culture.mystic-arts-in-teyvat: Non-Vision magic traditions (adeptal arts, exorcism, Hexenzirkel witchcraft). May overlap system/powers.

items.name: Phlogiston
items.notes: Natlan's programmable matter and energy, a form of dragon power. Liquid, solid and gaseous forms, plus Spiritways. | merged term.phlogiston: Natlan energy resource and technology base.

items.name: Stellar Glimmer Reaction
items.notes: Snezhnaya-linked Cryo reaction subset, enabled by Stellar Jubilee Passives (Stellar Linchpin users). It interrupts Snowland Fae, Aberrant Chimeric Monster and Leshy attacks.

items.name: Stellar Linchpin
items.notes: Snezhnayan Vision-like objects whose users (e.g. Vesna) have Stellar Jubilee Passives. The exact introduction version is not verified.

items.name: Adeptal Arts
items.notes: Adepti powers, adeptal energy and mechanisms (Qiqi's resurrection, Cloud Retainer's devices). No dedicated page; covered in the Liyue section of Mystic Arts.

items.name: Archaeolune Energy
items.notes: Ancient energy found on the Frost Moon. It is the primordial form of kuuvahki and shares traits with Phlogiston.

items.name: Arkhium
items.notes: Fontaine crystalline energy ore. A research explosion destroyed much of the Fontaine Research Institute. | merged item.arkhium: Fontaine crystal tied to Arkhe and Narzissenkreuz research.

items.name: Bloom
items.notes: Dendro + Hydro; creates Dendro Cores. The Bloom page also covers Hyperbloom and Burgeon.

items.name: Burning
items.notes: Pyro + Dendro.

items.name: Crystallize
items.notes: Geo + Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo; creates shield shards.

items.name: Electro-Charged
items.notes: Electro + Hydro.

items.name: Frozen
items.notes: Hydro + Cryo. Shatter is covered on the same wiki page.

items.name: Hexerei
items.notes: Hexerei: Secret Rite team bonus for 'Hexerei characters' (Hexenzirkel-linked: Sucrose, Mona, Durin, Klee, Albedo, Venti, Fischl, Razor...), unlocked through Witch's Homework. Includes the Witch's Eve Rite Passive.

items.name: Karma
items.notes: Corruptive residue of slain gods' wills (karmic debt). Afflicts the adepti (Xiao). | merged term.karma: Karmic debt/corruption afflicting the yakshas and adepti.

items.name: Khvarena
items.notes: Energy Nabu Malikata created to oppose the Cataclysm; purifies Abyssal energy. | merged term.khvarena: Sumeru concept of pure power opposing the Withering/Forbidden Knowledge.

items.name: Lunar-Bloom
items.notes: Dendro + Hydro Lunar variant that produces Verdant Dew. Introduced in Luna I (6.0).

items.name: Lunar-Charged
items.notes: Electro + Hydro Lunar variant that forms a thundercloud.

items.name: Lunar-Crystallize
items.notes: Geo + Hydro Lunar variant that creates Moondrifts. Introduced in Luna IV (6.3).

items.name: Melt
items.notes: Pyro + Cryo amplifying reaction.

items.name: Overloaded
items.notes: Pyro + Electro explosion.

items.name: Prime Ice
items.notes: Snezhnaya exploration mechanic: harvested with the Eye of Graeae's Fab-Vision to build Prime Ice Constructs.

items.name: Quicken
items.notes: Dendro + Electro aura. The wiki groups Quicken, Aggravate and Spread under 'Catalyze'.

items.name: Saurian Indwelling
items.notes: Spirit-indwelling into Saurians in Natlan.

items.name: Souls
items.notes: Synthesis entry (no wiki page): souls, ghosts, reincarnation, the Night Kingdom, Moon Wheels 'formed of soul-stuff', Snegovik with incomplete souls. Sources: Ghost, Night Kingdom, Moon Wheel, Snegovik.

items.name: Stamina
items.notes: Covers sprinting, climbing, swimming and gliding costs.

items.name: Statue of The Seven
items.notes: Healing and stamina statues; in lore, Archon worship sites. | merged term.statue-of-the-seven: Archon statues across Teyvat; religious/everyday landmark concept.

items.name: Stellar-Conduct
items.notes: Cryo + Electro Stellar Glimmer reaction that creates a Starlight Prism and a Polestar Field. Listed under New Systems in Luna VIII (6.7).

items.name: Stellar Swirl
items.notes: Anemo + Cryo Stellar Glimmer reaction that creates a Stellar Vortex. Added in 7.0.

items.name: Superconduct
items.notes: Electro + Cryo; Physical RES shred.

items.name: Swirl
items.notes: Anemo + Pyro/Hydro/Electro/Cryo; spreads the element.

items.name: Talent
items.notes: Combat, Ascension and Passive talents.

items.name: Vaporize
items.notes: Pyro + Hydro amplifying reaction.

items.name: Witchcraft
items.notes: Hexenzirkel magic and witch traditions. The organization belongs in the faction scope; this entry covers the power itself. The page title is a guess, so check it.

items.name: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
items.notes: Illness from abyssal exposure, treated with the Draught of Lucidity. Could be merged into system.abyssal-corruption.

items.name: Aggravate
items.notes: Electro on a Quickened target. Redirects to Catalyze, so this could be merged into system.quicken.

items.name: Ascension Phase
items.notes: Character and weapon ascension.

items.name: Azosite
items.notes: Khaenri'ahn energy refined from ley-line elemental energy into Energy Blocks.

items.name: Bond of Life
items.notes: Healing-absorption mechanic.

items.name: Burgeon
items.notes: Pyro on a Dendro Core. Redirects to Bloom, so this could be merged into system.bloom.

items.name: Diving
items.notes: Underwater exploration in Fontaine, with the Pneuma/Ousia-linked blessing of the Hydro Archon.

items.name: Elemental Burst
items.notes: Energy-based ultimate. Could be merged into system.talents.

items.name: Elemental Mastery
items.notes: Attribute that scales reaction damage.

items.name: Elemental Resonance
items.notes: Team bonus for party elements. Wiki section: Team Bonus#Elemental Resonance.

items.name: Elemental Sight
items.notes: Exploration sense.

items.name: Elemental Skill
items.notes: Could be merged into system.talents.

items.name: Energy
items.notes: Burst resource; elemental particles.

items.name: Exorcism
items.notes: Liyue and Inazuma exorcist traditions (Chongyun, Xinyan's... Yae's shrine, Hu Tao's parlor). Related to Fetor.

items.name: Fetor
items.notes: Energy that leaks when the border between life and death is disrupted. Neither Abyssal nor divine.

items.name: Hyperbloom
items.notes: Electro on a Dendro Core. Redirects to Bloom, so this could be merged into system.bloom.

items.name: Moonsign Benediction Passive
items.notes: Passive Talent that enables Lunar Reactions. Belongs to Nod-Krai characters and Zibai. Could be merged into system.moonsign.

items.name: Party
items.notes: Four-character party and character swapping. In-world, the Traveler's party switching is a game abstraction.

items.name: Physical
items.notes: Non-elemental damage type (the eighth damage type).

items.name: Shattered
items.notes: A Geo or blunt hit on a Frozen target. There is no separate wiki page (redirects to Frozen), so this could be merged into system.frozen.

items.name: Shield
items.notes: Character and enemy shields.

items.name: Spiritway
items.notes: Phlogiston flow routes in Natlan. Could be merged into system.phlogiston.

items.name: Spread
items.notes: Dendro on a Quickened target. Redirects to Catalyze, so this could be merged into system.quicken.

items.name: Stellar Jubilee Passive
items.notes: Passive Talent that enables Stellar Glimmer reactions. Belongs to Stellar Linchpin users and the Cryo Traveler.

items.name: Teleport Waypoint
items.notes: Fast travel.

items.name: Witch's Homework
items.notes: Uses The Little Witch's Dictionary to unlock Hexerei characters' Witch's Eve Rite Passive.

items.name: Witch's Revelation
items.notes: Unlocks the Witch's Revelation Passive for certain characters.
